== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings|The shears are a pair of ancient bronze daggers used by the [[Gardeners]], an elite group of assassins and [[Consultants]] within the [[Aurelian Empire]]. These weapons have been passed down through many generations, accumulating a massive amount of [[Intent]] over thousands of years. This accumulated power makes the shears exceptionally lethal; they can easily pierce bone, cut through hidden armor as if it were fabric, and deliver wounds that are almost certainly fatal. While they are highly effective in combat, they are not designed for throwing; [[Gardeners]] instead use small triangular [[steel]] knives called [[spades]] for such tasks. Each [[Gardener]] typically carries a pair of shears, though only the most senior members of the [[Guild]] are awarded true sets. The weapons possess a unique history and can be Awakened, a process that imbues them with distinct visual properties and shared consciousness. For example, an Awakened shear might glow with various colors like green, blue, purple, or orange, and may manifest physical traits such as undulating waves, butterfly-like light, or even eyes on the blades. One specific set of shears is noted for carrying a weight of [[Intent]] so significant it could potentially destroy [[Heart of Nakothi|Nakothi’s Heart]]. Because they are considered [[Guild]] property, their use and [[Awakening]] are subject to strict regulation.}}

== Of Killers and Kings ==
{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings|For thousands of years, the shears of the [[Gardeners]] have been passed down through successive generations of assassins. These tools are specifically awarded to those who reach the highest seniority within the order, prompting the [[Guild]] to invest in them. [[Meia]] possesses a pair of shears that evolved from knives into long, thin blades with a dull yellow topaz color and bright orange eyes on the blades featuring vertical slits. In contrast, [[Benji]]'s shears are purple and shaped like hooked sickles, accompanied by a cloud of butterflies composed of purple light.}}

<div class="wv-facts mw-collapsible mw-collapsed"><div class="wv-facts-head mw-collapsible-toggle">Sourced facts <span class="wv-facts-count">6</span></div>
<ul class="wv-fact-list mw-collapsible-content">
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings|The [[shears]] of the [[Gardeners]] have been handed down from assassin to assassin for thousands of years.<ref name="ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings-c5">''Of Killers and Kings'', chapter 5</ref>}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings|The most senior [[Gardeners]] are awarded [[shears]].<ref name="ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings-c10">''Of Killers and Kings'', chapter 10</ref>}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings|[[The Guild]] is investing in [[shears|Gardener shears]].<ref name="ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings-c22">''Of Killers and Kings'', chapter 22</ref>}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings|[[shears|Meia's shears]] are a pair of knives that grew longer and thinner, turned a dull yellow like topaz, and feature shining orange eyes with vertically slitted pupils.<ref name="ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings-c22" />}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings|[[shears|Benji's shears]] are purple and hooked like sickles, surrounded by a cloud of butterflies made of purple light.<ref name="ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings-c22" />}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings|[[shears|Meia's shears]] have orange eyeballs on the blades that shine brightly.<ref name="ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings-c25">''Of Killers and Kings'', chapter 25</ref>}}</li>
</ul></div>
